members.name: banking77_v1
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank (card, app, top-ups, transfers, currency exchange) wrote this message to support. Which single intent best describes what the customer wants or is reporting?

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card they already have / received; activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; can children/teens use it.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or phone wallets with the card; adding card to Apple/Google Pay. Includes getting top-ups to work through Apple Pay / Google Pay. Examples: "Can you please assist me in Apple Pay, in getting Top Up to work?"
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, finding an ATM, using the card at ATMs in general (not a specific failed withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up: setting it up, how it works, whether it exists, turning it off. Examples: "What, if any, is the limit  for auto top-up?"
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money sent into their account by bank transfer has not shown up in the balance yet; incoming transfer not reflected. Includes a bank transfer they already made (e.g. from their UK account) that is not showing up in the balance, even when phrased as asking how long transfers take. Examples: "What's the time frame normally for a UK account transfer? I just made one and it's not showing up anywhere. I want to be sure that everything is good." | "Why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?"
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit they made is not showing in the balance. A generic 'deposit' that isn't showing belongs here. Examples: "My cheque is slow to cash" | "I recently deposited some money into my account, but it still isn't showing up. What's going on?"
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or a transfer is refused because the beneficiary is not allowed. Includes a transfer to a particular account not being allowed. Examples: "the transfer to an account wasn't allowed is there any other way for me to do it"
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account). Examples: "I want to take back my transaction"
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon or expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used / is accepted; a merchant or shop does not accept the card.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; where is my card; tracking the card delivery. Physical card delivery only; not virtual cards.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when will a new card arrive (general timing, express delivery).
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app/account, re-linking a found card, connecting an existing card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working / not functioning in general (not specifically contactless, virtual, or a declined payment). Not for problems at an ATM (declined_cash_withdrawal) or at a shop payment when a payment was refused. Does include the card not working in several places / repeatedly. Examples: "There is something wrong with my card. Tried to use it a few times today in different places and it just didn't work. The transactions I tried to make were really small so not sure what's going on"
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: An unexpected fee was charged on a card payment/purchase.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment in the statement they don't recognise / didn't make. Applies even when they also ask whether to freeze or hold the card. Examples: "I need help with some transactions in my account that I dont recognize or remember purchasing. Im not sure if the name is just different or what. Should my card be put on hold while the issue gets figured out to be safe or is it ok?"
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment/purchase abroad. Examples: "It seems that the rate I got is incorrect."
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash; ATM withdrawal fees. Examples: "Why did I get charged a fee, I thought it was free?"
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal in the account they did not make or don't recognise. Includes cash shown in the app/statement that they never withdrew. Not when the ATM dispensed less than requested (wrong_amount_of_cash_received). Examples: "My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive."
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change or reset the card PIN. Only changing or resetting an existing PIN, not a PIN they never received.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised/hacked/skimmed; someone else may have used their card; fraud concern.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service/account is available in; using the service while living in or moving to another country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined/rejected at a shop or online. Only when the payment was actually refused/declined.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined; could not get cash out. Includes the card not working at an ATM. Examples: "My card wont work at an ATM"
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined/rejected by the bank. Examples: "I have tried a couple of times to make a purchase and my card keeps getting declined. Why do you keep denying my transfers? I have already tried a couple of times and it's not working."
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account they don't recognise. Examples: "i do not know what this charge is for"
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many cards, restrictions. Only about disposable virtual cards specifically.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees/charges for currency exchange. Includes asking for discounted exchange rates/fees for frequent exchanges. Examples: "If I exchange currency frequently, can I get a discounted rate?"
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, how rates are determined, current rates (general question).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app; whether they can exchange money.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge (often a small amount like £1) on the statement; 'why was I charged extra'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / did not go through / bounced back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which (fiat) currencies can be held, exchanged or used; support for a specific currency. Includes whether exchanges in a specific currency (e.g. EUR) are allowed. Examples: "Are EUR exchanges allowed?"
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card (e.g. after having a virtual one); where to find the PIN of a new physical card. Includes not having received / not knowing where their card PIN is. Examples: "Why have I not received my PIN"
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card, e.g. for family members. Includes how many (physical) cards they can have in total. Examples: "What's the limit on total number of cards I can have?"
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a virtual card; whether virtual cards are available. Includes an ordered virtual card that hasn't come through yet. Examples: "I ordered a virtual card but it hasn't come through yet"
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen; what to do. Examples: "Can you help me retrieve my card?"
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; accessing the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a (new) physical card; ordering process, delivery options, card from abroad.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; resetting the app passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending; why is it pending, how long pending lasts. Includes a payment that 'hasn't gone through yet' after a while (not refused). Examples: "I was wondering why my payment hasn't gone through yet, its been a while."
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending / not completed yet. Includes a completed top-up whose funds are not showing yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer they made is still pending / in progress. A transfer explicitly shown as pending/in progress, or asking how long the wait for their (urgent) transfer will be. Includes 'when will the transaction post to my account'. Examples: "My transfer is quite urgent, and finally worked out, but I've been waiting for it for quite some time. Can you tell me how long to expect to wait for it?" | "When will the transaction post to my account?"
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or locked after wrong attempts; unblocking the PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / payments / salary into the account; receiving money from others. Includes questions about adding/getting their salary paid into the account. Also how others/friends can send them money (including in another currency) and receiving a transfer. Examples: "Do I need to add my salary?" | "Can I use a transfer to receive my transfer?" | "Can my friend send me money if it is not in US dollars?"
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request or get a refund for a purchase. Examples: "I no longer want this can i cancel my purchase?"
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled back unexpectedly. Includes a purchase where money was deducted and then returned to the account, or the seller says the payment didn't go through. Examples: "I bought something and already paid for it but now I don't see it." | "I just found out from the seller that my money didn't go through. I checked my account and it was deducted at first but now it's back in my account. Can you  please fix this for me quickly?"
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card types and currencies are supported, e.g. for top-ups or payments. Includes whether a specific card brand (e.g. American Express) can be used to add money. Examples: "Am I able to add money into my account using my American Express?" | "what currencies can i use to add money to my account"
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined. Includes a top-up that did not work or 'not sure my top-up went through', and money not accessible because a top-up went wrong. Messages may contain typos (e.g. 'pop-up' for top-up). Examples: "I'm not sure if my pop-up went through." | "I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly."
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled/returned, or money disappeared after a top-up.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card; top-up by card process or problems. Includes whether other people can top up their account. Examples: "Can other people top up my account?"
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction/payment was charged twice (duplicate charge).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer. Includes being charged a fee for banking/sending money abroad. Examples: "Could you inform me as to why I have been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad." | "This isn't fair! I thought transfers could be made for free. I just made  a purchase online from abroad and now see some strange fee that I've never seen before."
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into their own account / top up via bank transfer. Examples: "My money is all gone. What ways are okay to add money to my account?"
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer they sent has not arrived at the recipient. Includes a transfer they sent that is taking too long, has not gone through or arrived yet, or they worry too much time has passed — even when phrased as 'how long does it take'. Examples: "I have done a transfer within the country the day before yesterday, but it's still not there yet. Can you please check what's going on with that, the account number is the right one, I've checked that several times already." | "I transferred some money but it is not here yet" | "How long does it take for money to transfer?  I sent some to a friend and it hasn't gone through yet." | "I am worried that too much time has gone by for a transfer to be completed."
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive (general timing). General timing questions, and 'how much longer' while waiting for an incoming transfer when they don't say it already left the sender or is missing from the balance. Includes 'when can I expect my transfer to reach my account'. Examples: "When can I expect my transfer to reach my account?" | "I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?"
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or not working; can't complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify their identity; what documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying/proving the source of funds; where the money comes from. Includes questions about where their funds come from / flow from. Examples: "How can I find out where the funds are flow?"
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code / verifying a top-up card; top-up verification. Includes a missing verification code for a card used to add money. Examples: "I don't see the verification code for my card transfer."
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing the card network. Includes 'do you accept Visa or Mastercard'. Examples: "I'm wanting to get a Visa card today." | "Do you accept Visa or Mastercard?"
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required. Includes 'do I have to verify who I am?'. Examples: "Do i have to verify who I am?"
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.
